hook: POV: your story is spread across a dozen notes, two notebooks and your head.
tiktok:
I made a comic planner for when your story is spread across a dozen notes and your head. Characters, secret identities, power levels, issues and pages, all connected, and it draws the maps for you.

It's free to start in your browser (link in bio).

What's the one thing you always forget about your own characters?
